{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates based on patient_id and sample_seq
print("Duplicate patient_id entries:", trial_df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())
print("Total rows:", len(trial_df))
print("Unique patient_ids:", trial_df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check if multiple sample_seq entries exist per patient
sample_seq_counts = trial_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].count()
print("Patients with multiple sample_seq entries:", (sample_seq_counts > 1).sum())

# Identify the highest sample_seq for each patient
trial_df_sorted = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
trial_df_deduped = trial_df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Verify deduplication
print("After deduplication - rows:", len(trial_df_deduped))
print("After deduplication - unique patient_ids:", trial_df_deduped['patient_id'].nunique())

# Now focus on the question: mean baseline biomarker value among patients with SEVERE disease
severe_patients = trial_df_deduped[trial_df_deduped['severity'] == 'severe']

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("Sentinel values in biomarker_baseline for SEVERE patients:", severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'].isin([-999.0]).sum())

# Filter out sentinel values
severe_patients_valid = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]
mean_biomarker_severe_valid = severe_patients_valid['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

print(f"Number of valid SEVERE patients (excluding -999.0): {len(severe_patients_valid)}")
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value for SEVERE patients (excluding -999.0): {mean_biomarker_severe_valid}")"}
